Pilot · United States

Chesley "Sully" Sullenberger

US Airways Flight 15492009
Flight
US Airways Flight 1549
Date
15 January 2009
Aircraft
Airbus A320
Location
Hudson River, New York
Survivors
155 of 155 aboard

After a bird strike knocked out both engines shortly after takeoff from LaGuardia, the captain ditched the Airbus A320 on the Hudson River. All 155 people aboard survived.

Who helped

  • Jeffrey Skiles First officerWorked the engine restart checklist after the bird strike while Sullenberger flew, and helped the crew get everyone off the sinking aircraft.Sources: 1 2 3 4Photo: Susan Ruggles from Milwaukee, USA · CC BY 2.0
  • Doreen Welsh Flight attendantWorked the rear of the cabin as cold water poured in and helped get passengers out, while suffering a deep wound to her leg.Sources: 1 2 3 4
  • Sheila Dail Flight attendantPrepared passengers for impact and worked a forward exit door, helping the crew evacuate all 150 passengers within minutes.Sources: 1 2 3 4
  • Donna Dent Flight attendantPrepared passengers for impact and helped evacuate everyone from the front of the plane onto the slide rafts and wings.Sources: 1 2 3 4
  • Vincent Lombardi Ferry captain (NY Waterway, Thomas Jefferson)Captained the ferry Thomas Jefferson, the first vessel to reach the plane, where his crew pulled 56 people out of the river and off the wings.Sources: 1 2 3 4
  • Brittany Catanzaro Ferry captain (NY Waterway, Governor Thomas H. Kean)Captained the ferry Governor Thomas H. Kean, steering it beside the drifting plane so her crew could lift survivors aboard.Sources: 1 2 3 4 5Photo: USCG · Public domain
  • Vincent Lucante Ferry port captain (NY Waterway, Yogi Berra)Took the out-of-service ferry Yogi Berra to the scene and steered it alongside a life raft so survivors, including an infant, could be lifted aboard.Sources: 1 2 3
  • Michael Delaney NYPD Harbor Unit scuba diverJumped from a police helicopter into the river and calmed a panicking, freezing woman clinging to a ferry, helping get her aboard.Sources: 1 2 3 4
  • Robert Rodriguez NYPD Harbor Unit scuba diverJumped from a police helicopter into the river with his partner Michael Delaney to bring a struggling woman to safety on a ferry.Sources: 1 2 3 4
  • Patrick Harten Air traffic controller (New York TRACON)Handled the emergency by radio, offering LaGuardia runways and arranging a landing at Teterboro before the crew said they would ditch in the Hudson.Sources: 1 2 3

Source: en.wikipedia.org/wiki/US_Airways_Flight_1549 ↗
